sources.name: DEC-299 Gate A build
sources.detail: Board-approved Gate A: tokens-fuel-spellcopy, Bracket 3+/4-, 1 tutor (Enlightened Tutor), 2 two-card combos (Heliod+Walking Ballista, Kiki-Jiki+Felidar Guardian).

sources.name: DEC-299 v2 swaps
sources.detail: Board-requested v2 (2026-05-27): cut Generous Gift→Fateful Absence; Wing Shards→Clever Concealment; Wheel of Misfortune→Magus of the Wheel; Heraldic Banner→Voice of Victory; Hanweir Garrison→Elspeth, Storm Slayer; Faithless Looting→Enduring Innocence; Light Up the Stage→Caretaker's Talent. Net: stronger token-ETB draw engines + permanent-phase-out protection + opp-no-spells-on-my-turn silence.

sources.name: BMK Aziza decklist comparison
sources.detail: Mined the BMK Aziza list ($392, Commander at Home) for ideas. Confirmed our spell-copy/combo lean is stronger; cherry-picked token-multiplication and combo-enabler ideas from BMK.

sources.name: DEC-299 v5 swaps
sources.detail: Board-approved v5 (2026-05-27, 7 swaps from BMK audit): Lightning Bolt→Restoration Angel (v3); Servo Exhibition→Mentor of the Meek (v3.5); Twinflame→Secure the Wastes + Heroic Reinforcements→Grand Crescendo (v4 Option A); Captain's Call→Ojer Taq Deepest Foundation; Lightning Helix→Impact Tremors; Cave of the Frost Dragon→Windbrisk Heights; Treasure Map→Idol of Oblivion; Reckless Impulse→Flawless Maneuver; Wear // Tear→Staff of the Storyteller; Intangible Virtue→Forth Eorlingas! Net effect: 4 token multipliers (Anointed Procession + Mondrak + Elspeth + Ojer Taq = 24x token stack), 5 token-ETB draw layers, 5-combo-piece consistency.

sources.name: DEC-299 v6 swaps
sources.detail: Board-approved v6 (2026-05-27, 4 round-2 swaps from BMK revisit): Hordeling Outburst→Antiquities on the Loose (2/2 spirits + flashback rider); Birgi→Haliya Guided by Light (lifegain-keyed draw + warp {W} early-cast); Battle Screech→The Last Ronin's Technique (sneak 2-mana 3 attacking tokens = lethal w/ multipliers + Impact Tremors); Vandalblast→Warleader's Call (Impact Tremors clone + +1/+1 anthem all creatures).

sources.name: DEC-299 v8 swap
sources.detail: Board-approved v8 (2026-05-27): cut Roaming Throne (€33, narrow — only doubles 7 Human-typed triggers); add Wedding Announcement (€3-5, 3-CMC saga: 1/1 Human tokens + attack-2-draw + transforms into permanent +1/+1 anthem). Net: cheaper, lower curve, permanent anthem the deck didn't have.

sources.name: DEC-303 v9 aggression swaps
sources.detail: Board-approved v9 (2026-05-27, 7 swaps from aggression audit): Reforge the Soul→Imperial Recruiter (combo tutor for Kiki/Felidar/Walking Ballista/Young Pyromancer/Mother of Runes); Idol of Oblivion→Ranger-Captain of Eos (silence sac for combo turn + MV≤1 tutor for Walking Ballista/Mother of Runes); Mentor of the Meek→Mother of Runes (1-MV body, instant-speed targeted protection for Aziza/Kiki/Heliod); Increasing Devotion→Empty the Warrens (storm bomb, scales with multiplier stack to 32-192 tokens); Hour of Reckoning→Intangible Virtue (re-adds the v2 cut — solves the vigilance bottleneck so the deck can attack AND tap-3 for Aziza on the same turn); Big Score→Guttersnipe (passive 2-dmg/opp per I/S hardcast — drain layer that fires on every spell turn); Wrenn's Resolve→Jeska's Will (GC#3 — both modes active with commander on field: opponent-hand mana surge + 3 impulses, Aziza-copyable for a second round on another opp). Also added winConditions[] block to expose 5 win lines to the simulator (was reporting 0% combo lethal). Rewrote strategyOverview to drop 20 stale card references from prior versions (v2/v5/v6/v8 cuts: Hordeling Outburst, Servo Exhibition, Captain's Call, Battle Screech, Hanweir Garrison, Birgi, Roaming Throne, Light Up the Stage, Faithless Looting, Twinflame, Bonus Round, Heraldic Banner, Heroic Reinforcements, Wheel of Misfortune, Generous Gift, Lightning Bolt, Lightning Helix, Vandalblast, Wear // Tear, the dangling Intangible Virtue ref). Net: curve avg 2.82→~2.67, vigilance solved, combo tutors 1→3, GC 2→3.

sources.name: Board exclusions (DEC-299 + DEC-303)
sources.detail: No Force of Will, Mana Vault, Ancient Tomb, Grim Monolith, The One Ring, Demonic/Vampiric Tutor, Mana Crypt. EU-budget exclusions (DEC-303): Mox Amber (€50+), Esper Sentinel (€50+).

sources.name: DEC-306 v10 swap
sources.detail: Board-approved v10 (2026-05-28, DEC-306): cut Magus of the Wheel → add Flashback ({R} Instant, SOS). Magus had the fewest synergy hooks of any non-locked card (creature-only, no Aziza copy, no tutor reach via Imperial Recruiter/Ranger-Captain, no token/draw layer interaction). Redundant with Jeska's Will + Unexpected Windfall + Smothering Tithe + 5 token-keyed draw layers. Slot becomes 1-mana instant-speed yard recursion: target any I/S in graveyard gains flashback EOT — Aziza copies the Flashback cast (2 untapped targets per cast), each flashback recast triggers Aziza again, and Storm-Kiln Artist's Magecraft fires on both the original cast and the Aziza copy. Replays X-spells (Empty the Warrens with storm, Secure the Wastes, Forth Eorlingas!, Grand Crescendo) at a bigger X via late-game mana surge from Jeska's Will / Smothering Tithe. Second-choice cuts considered and rejected: Increasing Vengeance (functional overlap but Aziza-doublable wincon multiplier), Reverberate (only opp-spell copy line).

guideContent.strategyOverview:
Aziza, Mage Tower Captain is a {R}{W} 2/2 Djinn Sorcerer whose trigger reads: 'Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may tap three untapped creatures you control. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.' This Boros tokens-fuel-spellcopy build exploits both halves: token bodies become the tap-3 fuel; every instant/sorcery becomes a payoff that doubles for free. **Vigilance is the central enabler** — Intangible Virtue gives every token vigilance, which is what lets the deck attack AND tap three creatures for Aziza on the same turn.

The token engine runs cheap, high-rate token producers (Krenko's Command, Antiquities on the Loose, Secure the Wastes, Grand Crescendo, Forth Eorlingas!, Empty the Warrens with storm, The Last Ronin's Technique) plus attack-trigger engines (Brimaz King of Oreskos, Adeline Resplendent Cathar, Voice of Victory, Anim Pakal Thousandth Moon). Ajani Nacatl Pariah enters as a 1/2 with a 2/1 cat token and flips into a +1/+1 anthem walker when any cat dies — Aziza fuel twice (ETB + flip pump). Wedding Announcement makes a 1/1 Human end-step token (or draws if you swung wide) and transforms into a permanent +1/+1 anthem after 3 turns.

The spellslinger payoff layer converts every spell cast into damage and bodies: Young Pyromancer (1/1 elemental per I/S cast), Monastery Mentor (prowess + 1/1 monk per noncreature), Storm-Kiln Artist (Treasure per cast OR Aziza copy via Magecraft), Guttersnipe (2 damage to each opponent per I/S cast). Magecraft is the key text — Storm-Kiln Artist fires on copies AND casts, so Aziza's spell-copy generates a Treasure each fire. Pyromancer, Mentor, and Guttersnipe fire only on casts (CR 707.10 — Aziza copies are not cast), but every hardcast turn triggers all four simultaneously.

Card advantage is split between draw layers and impulse engines: Caretaker's Talent and Enduring Innocence both draw once per turn on token/power-2 ETB; Wedding Announcement draws on wide attacks; Staff of the Storyteller charges story counters per token creation; Haliya Guided by Light draws when you gain 3+ life; Skullclamp turns 1-toughness tokens into 2 cards. Unexpected Windfall reloads empty hands. **Jeska's Will** doubles down whenever Aziza is on the battlefield — CR 903.3d defines 'controlling a commander' as a commander permanent on the battlefield, so Aziza in the CZ does NOT enable both modes. With Aziza on the field: +R per card in target opponent's hand AND exile-and-play 3 cards; her trigger then copies the spell (3 untapped creatures required), the copy inherits both modes (CR 706.10d), and you re-target Mode 1 to another opponent for a second mana surge plus 3 more impulsed cards. With Aziza only in the CZ, you get one mode of Jeska's Will and no copy — still useful, but a fraction of the payoff. The deck's play pattern is therefore: resolve Aziza first (median T2), then deploy Jeska's Will from T3 onward.

Anthems and doublers compound the swarm: Anointed Procession + Mondrak Glory Dominus + Elspeth Storm Slayer (3 doublers) stack to 8x tokens per creation event; add Ojer Taq Deepest Foundation (tripler) for a 24x stack. Cathars' Crusade puts +1/+1 counters on the entire board every time ANY creature enters — a 4-goblin Krenko's Command becomes +4/+4 across the team. Intangible Virtue gives every token vigilance + anthem. Purphoros God of the Forge converts ETBs into 2 damage to each opponent; Impact Tremors and Warleader's Call stack additional 1-damage drains per ETB (Warleader's Call also pumps every creature +1/+1).

Three win lines: (1) **Combat go-wide** — turn 6-8 swing with a doubled board buffed by Cathars' Crusade and triggered drains. The Last Ronin's Technique sneak'd via an unblocked attacker creates 3 attacking tokens; with multipliers and Impact Tremors + Purphoros + Warleader's Call stacked, it's a one-card lethal. (2) **Heliod Sun-Crowned + Walking Ballista** — Heliod's {1}{W} grants Ballista lifelink, then Ballista (with ≥1 counter from cast X≥1 or Cathars' Crusade) pings for 1 → gains 1 life → +1/+1 counter trigger → infinite damage. (3) **Kiki-Jiki Mirror Breaker + Felidar Guardian / Restoration Angel** — Kiki copies the creature with haste, the copy's ETB blinks Kiki, Kiki returns and copies again. Infinite hasted attackers same turn; Impact Tremors / Purphoros / Warleader's Call close on infinite ETBs. Goblin Bombardment converts each hasted Kiki copy into 1 damage to any target before the EOT sacrifice trigger — alternate burn line.

Combo consistency: three tutor effects find the pieces. **Enlightened Tutor** for any artifact/enchantment (Cathars' Crusade, Anointed Procession, Heliod, Goblin Bombardment). **Imperial Recruiter** for power-2-or-less creatures — hits Kiki-Jiki (2/2), Felidar Guardian (1/4), Walking Ballista (printed 0 power), Young Pyromancer, Mother of Runes, Voice of Victory, Storm-Kiln Artist. **Ranger-Captain of Eos** for MV-1-or-less creatures (Walking Ballista, Mother of Runes); the sac ability silences opponents' noncreature spells for the combo turn.

Interaction is 5 instant-speed spot-removal slots (Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Fateful Absence, Chaos Warp, Boros Charm) plus 1 asymmetric sweeper (Settle the Wreckage — exiles attackers and ramps the victim) and the team-protection layer Akroma's Will (whole team gets double strike + indestructible + protection). Sweeper insurance via Clever Concealment (instant-speed convoke phase-out — often 1-2 mana real cost with a wide board) and Flawless Maneuver (free indestructible with commander on the field). Mother of Runes adds targeted protection-from-color on Aziza, Kiki, Heliod, or Walking Ballista as needed. Voice of Victory's static ability ('Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn') lets Aziza copy chains resolve uncontested.

Bracket 3+/4-: 3 Game Changers (Enlightened Tutor, Smothering Tithe, Jeska's Will). Honors board exclusions: no Force of Will, Mana Vault, Ancient Tomb, Grim Monolith, The One Ring, Demonic/Vampiric Tutor, Mana Crypt. EU-budget exclusions: Mox Amber (€50+), Esper Sentinel (€50+). v9 swaps prioritized vigilance fix + curve compression + combo tutors + 3rd GC over slow value engines (Reforge the Soul, Idol of Oblivion, Mentor of the Meek, Increasing Devotion, Hour of Reckoning, Big Score, Wrenn's Resolve).

highlights.name: Aziza, Mage Tower Captain
highlights.reason: Commander. Every I/S you cast copies for free if you can tap three creatures. Tokens are the fuel; spells are the payoff.

highlights.name: Ajani, Nacatl Pariah
highlights.reason: Board-requested. ETB makes a 2/1 cat token (Aziza fuel). Flips on cat-death into a +1/+1 anthem walker. Hard to remove with one answer.

highlights.name: Anim Pakal, Thousandth Moon
highlights.reason: Board-requested. Snowballing attack trigger: +1/+1 counter + X 1/1 tapped+attacking Gnome tokens where X is her counter count. By turn 5 the board floods on combat.

highlights.name: Wedding Announcement
highlights.reason: v8 add (replaced Roaming Throne for budget + breadth). 3-mana saga: end-step generates a 1/1 Human token OR draws a card if you attacked with 2+ creatures (trivial in this deck). After 3 invitation counters, transforms into Wedding Festivity — a permanent +1/+1 anthem to all creatures. Tokens + draw + permanent anthem in one card.

highlights.name: Cathars' Crusade
highlights.reason: Every creature ETB stacks +1/+1 counters on the entire board. A 3-token spell from Hordeling Outburst pumps every creature you control by +3/+3. Token-deck linchpin.

highlights.name: Heliod, Sun-Crowned
highlights.reason: Two-card combo piece with Walking Ballista. Heliod's {1}{W} grants Ballista lifelink; Ballista pings 1 → 1 life gained → +1/+1 counter trigger → infinite damage. Win on turn 5-7 if assembled.

highlights.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
highlights.reason: Two-card combo piece with Felidar Guardian. Kiki copies Felidar with haste, copy's ETB blinks Kiki, Kiki returns and copies again. Infinite hasted 3/4 attackers same turn.

highlights.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
highlights.reason: 2 damage to each opponent per creature ETB. Slow drain wincon and Kiki-combo amplifier — infinite ETBs = infinite damage to all opponents simultaneously.

highlights.name: Intangible Virtue
highlights.reason: v9 re-add (was v2 cut). {1}{W} enchantment: creature tokens get +1/+1 AND vigilance. **The vigilance bottleneck fix** — tokens can attack and still tap for Aziza's 'tap 3 creatures to copy a spell' cost on the same turn. Anthem stacks with Cathars' Crusade, Wedding Festivity, Warleader's Call.

highlights.name: Imperial Recruiter
highlights.reason: v9 add (~€10). 3-MV ETB: tutor any power-2-or-less creature. In this deck that's 11 hits including BOTH combo pieces: Kiki-Jiki (2/2), Felidar Guardian (1/4), Walking Ballista (0 printed power), plus Young Pyromancer, Mother of Runes, Voice of Victory, Storm-Kiln Artist, Ajani, Anim Pakal, Haliya, Monastery Mentor. Combo consistency upgrade — Kiki line now setups in T6-7 routinely.

highlights.name: Ranger-Captain of Eos
highlights.reason: v9 add. 3-MV 3/3 ETB: tutor any MV-1-or-less creature (Walking Ballista, Mother of Runes). Sac ability is the real value: opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn — silences the table on your combo turn or alpha strike, resolving copy chains uncontested.

highlights.name: Mother of Runes
highlights.reason: v9 add. 1-MV 1/1 cleric: tap to give a creature you control protection-from-color until EOT. Single-handedly defeats targeted removal on Aziza, Kiki-Jiki, Heliod, Walking Ballista, or any threat. Cheap body + free repeatable protection.

highlights.name: Empty the Warrens
highlights.reason: v9 add. 4-MV sorcery: create 2 1/1 Goblin tokens + **storm** (copy for each spell cast before it this turn). Cast as 3rd spell of turn → 1 original + 2 storm copies + 1 Aziza copy = 4 instances of 'create 2 goblins' = 8 goblins base. With Mondrak + Procession (4x) = 32 goblins; full 4-multiplier stack = 192. Storm count plus Aziza-copy plus multiplier stack = one-card alpha strike.

highlights.name: Guttersnipe
highlights.reason: v9 add. 3-MV 2/2 goblin shaman: 2 damage to each opponent per I/S **cast**. Aziza copies don't trigger (copies aren't cast — CR 707.10), but every hardcast does. With 6-8 hardcasts per game = 12-16 damage per opponent of passive drain, fires on every removal spell, every protection spell, every wheel. Pairs with Impact Tremors / Warleader's Call / Purphoros for 4 stackable drain layers.

highlights.name: Jeska's Will
highlights.reason: v9 add (Game Changer #3, ~€20). {2}{R} sorcery: choose one — OR **both** if you control a commander. CR 903.3d defines 'controlling a commander' as a commander permanent **on the battlefield**, so this gate requires Aziza on the field (CZ-only Aziza = one mode). Mode 1: Add {R} for each card in target opponent's hand (typically +4R to +7R = absurd mana surge). Mode 2: Exile top 3 cards, may play them this turn. With Aziza on the battlefield + 3 untapped creatures, her trigger copies the spell — the copy inherits both modes (CR 706.10d), and you may re-target Mode 1 to another opponent. Single highest aggression unlock in Boros for this deck once Aziza has resolved.

highlights.name: Voice of Victory
highlights.reason: v2 add. {1}{W} 3/3 with mobilize 2 (2 attacking warrior tokens on attack) AND 'Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn' — perfect silence on Aziza spellslinger turns. Lets you resolve copy chains uncontested.

highlights.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
highlights.reason: v2 add. 3rd token doubler in the deck (stacks with Anointed Procession + Mondrak = 8x tokens). +1 makes a Soldier, 0 puts +1/+1 counter on each creature with flying, -3 hits MV≥3 threats. Surviving Elspeth wins games.

highlights.name: Caretaker's Talent
highlights.reason: v2 add. Class enchantment: lvl 1 draws when tokens enter (once/turn). Lvl 2 ({W}) creates a copy of one of your tokens. Lvl 3 ({3}{W}) gives all your tokens +2/+2. Three-mode token engine that scales with the deck.

highlights.name: Enduring Innocence
highlights.reason: v2 add. {1}{W}{W} 1/3 lifelink. Power 2-or-less ETB → draw 1/turn (which is nearly every creature/token in this deck). Dies → returns as enchantment + creates a 1/1 token. Lifelink also enables Heliod's +1/+1 trigger.

highlights.name: Clever Concealment
highlights.reason: v2 add. {2}{W}{W} convoke instant: phase out ANY number of your nonland permanents. Survives every sweeper, removal spell, and counterspell — your board comes back untapped on your next turn. Convoke means it's often 1-2 mana real cost.

highlights.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation
highlights.reason: v5 add. {4}{W}{W} 5/5 vigilance God. **Token tripler**: when one or more creature tokens would be created, you get 3x. Stacks with Anointed Procession + Mondrak + Elspeth as a 4th multiplier — 1 token base becomes 24 tokens with the full stack. Dies-back-as-land insurance against removal.

highlights.name: Impact Tremors
highlights.reason: v5 add. {1}{R} enchantment: every creature ETB deals 1 damage to each opponent. **3rd Kiki-combo enabler** — at 2 mana setup cost vs Purphoros's 4. Also drains opponents across regular token-spam turns: a Hordeling Outburst with doublers becomes 6-24 damage to each opp.

highlights.name: Flawless Maneuver
highlights.reason: v5 add. {2}{W} instant — FREE if you control your commander. Creatures gain indestructible until EOT. Effectively a 0-mana board-wide protection while Aziza is on the field. Sweeper insurance + Kiki/Felidar combo protection.

highlights.name: Forth Eorlingas!
highlights.reason: v5 add. {X}{R}{W} sorcery: create X 2/2 red Human Knight tokens with **trample and haste**. Plus combat-damage → become monarch (passive draw engine). 2/2 bodies are bigger than 1/1, trample punches through chumps, and haste means immediate impact. X-spell that's Aziza-copyable.

highlights.name: Windbrisk Heights
highlights.reason: v5 add. Hideaway 4 land — exile one of the top 4 cards on ETB. When you attack with 3+ creatures, play that card without paying its mana cost. Trivial to activate in this deck (Adeline alone makes 3 attackers). Effectively a free spell every game.

highlights.name: Staff of the Storyteller
highlights.reason: v5 add. {1}{W} artifact: ETB creates a 1/1 white Spirit flyer; each token-creation event puts a story counter; pay {W}{T} remove a counter to draw a card. 5th token-draw layer + a free body.

highlights.name: Antiquities on the Loose
highlights.reason: v6 add. {1}{W}{W} sorcery: create two 2/2 red-and-white Spirit tokens. Aziza-copyable for 4 spirits total. Flashback {4}{W}{W} for 2 more (plus +1/+1 to all Spirits). 2/2 bodies are stronger than the 1/1s most token spells make.

highlights.name: Haliya, Guided by Light
highlights.reason: v6 add. {2}{W} legendary with warp {W} (1-mana early cast, exile EOT, replay later). Each creature/artifact ETB → gain 1 life. End step: if gained 3+ life this turn, draw. Token deck triggers her every turn AND her lifegain enables Heliod's +1/+1 counter trigger for combo acceleration.

highlights.name: The Last Ronin's Technique
highlights.reason: v6 add. {3}{W} normal, {1}{W} via sneak (return unblocked attacker). 3 1/1 Ninja Turtle Spirits — if sneak'd, enter tapped+attacking. With 4-multiplier stack: 3 → 72 tokens entering attacking. Impact Tremors + Purphoros + Warleader's Call = combat lethal in one card play.

highlights.name: Warleader's Call
highlights.reason: v6 add. {1}{R}{W} enchantment: +1/+1 to ALL creatures (not just tokens) AND 1 damage to each opponent on every creature ETB. Stacks with Impact Tremors for 2 dmg/ETB and Purphoros for another 2 dmg/ETB. Anthem + drain in one card.

synergies.description: Wedding Announcement makes a 1/1 Human token at end of turn if you didn't attack with 2+ creatures. Aziza's combat plan already attacks wide; the saga transforms after 3 turns into a permanent +1/+1 anthem (Wedding Festivity) — long-game value on top of the token/draw triggers.

Antiquities on the Loose has flashback ({4}{W}{W}) — cast from graveyard. Aziza copies the flashback cast for free token doubling. Plus the flashback rider puts +1/+1 counters on each Spirit you control. Effectively two payouts from one card.

Cast Secure the Wastes for X=4 (5 mana total); Aziza's trigger copies the spell with same X. Resolves as 4 tokens + 4 tokens = 8 1/1 warriors for 5 mana. With 3 token doublers (Anointed Procession + Mondrak + Elspeth) on board this becomes 64 tokens. Best Aziza-payoff instant in the deck.

Cast Grand Crescendo for X=4 (6 mana total); Aziza copies it. Resolves as 8 tokens + indestructible until EOT. The indestructible from the original applies to all your creatures regardless of the copy's tokens being made — instant-speed go-wide + sweeper protection rolled into one.

Each token ETB triggers Crusade, putting +1/+1 counters on the whole board. A 2-token spell becomes +2/+2 across every creature; with doublers/tripler, a token spell can stack 8-24 counters per creature.
Token doublers stack multiplicatively. With both out, every token-making effect produces 4x tokens.
Heliod's {1}{W} grants Ballista lifelink. Ballista pings for 1 → gains 1 life → Heliod's lifegain trigger → +1/+1 counter on Ballista → repeat. Infinite damage combo.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Heliod + Walking Ballista combo

synergies.description: Kiki copies Felidar with haste, copy's ETB blinks Kiki, Kiki untaps and copies again. Infinite hasted Felidar Guardian copies for combat lethal same turn.

Same loop as Kiki+Felidar but using a flash 3/4 flyer. Kiki copies Restoration Angel with haste; the Angel copy's ETB blinks Kiki (non-Angel target); Kiki returns and copies again. 5th combo piece — doubles consistency of the Kiki line.
Purphoros pings each opponent 2 per creature ETB. With the Kiki+Felidar loop active, this is infinite damage to all opponents — alternate finisher if combat is blocked.

Storm-Kiln Artist's Magecraft triggers on cast OR copy of an I/S spell. Every Aziza copy creates a Treasure, which can be sacrificed to fuel the next spell. Effectively a treasure-storm engine attached to spell-copy turns.
Every instant or sorcery spawns a 1/1 elemental (Pyromancer) and, if noncreature, a 1/1 prowess monk (Mentor). Aziza copies don't double these (copies aren't cast), but every hardcast spawns both.

Voice of Victory's static ability says 'Your opponents can't cast spells during your turn.' On Aziza's spellslinger turns where you cast multiple I/S and copy each, this prevents any reactive counter/removal — copy chains resolve uncontested.

All four are token multipliers (3 doublers + 1 tripler). Per CR 616, replacement effects chain — 1 token → 2 → 4 → 8 → 24. Krenko's Command (2 tokens) becomes 48 tokens; Secure the Wastes for X=4 with Aziza copy becomes 192 tokens for 5 mana.

Impact Tremors triggers on every creature ETB; the Kiki+Felidar/Restoration Angel loop creates infinite ETBs same turn = infinite damage to each opponent. 2-mana Impact Tremors is a faster Kiki-combo enabler than 4-mana Purphoros.

Adeline's attack trigger creates a token per opponent, so attacking with Adeline alone gives 3 attackers in a 4-player game — meets Windbrisk Heights' attack-with-3 condition. The hidden card plays for free.

Flawless Maneuver costs {2}{W} normally but is FREE if you control a commander. With Aziza on the board, instant-speed indestructible for the whole team for 0 mana — sweeper insurance that doesn't tap the deck.

Five token-keyed draw layers fire independently each turn — Caretaker's Talent (token ETB, once/turn), Enduring Innocence (power-2 ETB, once/turn), Staff of the Storyteller (token-creation event → story counter → {W}{T} draw), Haliya (3+ life gained → draw), Wedding Announcement (attack with 2+ → draw). With Skullclamp + Unexpected Windfall + Smothering Tithe + Jeska's Will rounding out hand refills, the deck almost never runs out of cards.

Both deal 1 damage to each opponent on creature ETB. Together = 2 damage per ETB to each opponent. With doublers + Ojer Taq stack, a single Krenko's Command becomes 48 token ETBs × 2 dmg = 96 damage to each opp. Warleader's Call also pumps all creatures +1/+1.

Sneak'd Last Ronin's (cost: 1 unblocked attacker returned + {1}{W}) creates 3 1/1 tokens entering tapped+attacking. With the 4-multiplier stack: 3 → 72 tokens. Impact Tremors triggers 72 times (72 dmg to each opp), Purphoros triggers 72 times (144 dmg to each opp), Warleader's Call adds another 72. Lethal in one card play after assembling.

Haliya gains 1 life on every creature/artifact ETB. With 5+ creatures entering per turn (tokens), Heliod's 'whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature/enchantment' triggers 5+ times per turn — accelerates Walking Ballista counter stacking and pumps any chosen creature/enchantment.

Aziza copies the hardcast spell — base 2 2/2 spirits + copy 2 2/2 spirits = 4 2/2 bodies for 3 mana. With multipliers: 4 → 8 → 16 → 32 → 96 2/2 spirits. Flashback ({4}{W}{W}) cast from graveyard also adds +1/+1 counters to all your spirits.

A 2-token spell triggers Caretaker's Talent (draw 1, once/turn) AND Enduring Innocence (draw 1, once/turn) AND adds 4 1/1s to the board (with Anointed Procession). Two repeatable draw triggers off every token spell.

Enduring Innocence has lifelink. Any combat damage gains life, triggering Heliod's +1/+1 counter ability. Combined with Walking Ballista already having lifelink via Heliod, multiple lifelink sources accelerate counter accumulation.

Sweeper insurance layer. Clever Concealment (instant convoke) phases your entire team out — survives any non-exile wrath, permanents return untapped on your next untap step. Settle the Wreckage exiles attackers, deterring opponents from threatening you in the first place. Together they cover both proactive and reactive board protection.
Clamp a 1/1 cat token from Ajani (or any 1-toughness token) — equipped creature gets +1/-1, dies, draw 2. Repeatable card advantage from spare tokens.

**Vigilance bottleneck fix.** Intangible Virtue gives all tokens vigilance. Anim Pakal attacks each turn (snowballing tapped+attacking Gnome tokens scaled by counter count) while remaining untapped — she is now perfect Aziza tap-3 fuel on the same turn she swings. Pre-v9, attacking emptied your untapped pool and locked Aziza out of copy-mode that turn. Now combat + copy chains co-exist.

Token spell with Intangible Virtue + Cathars' Crusade out: Krenko's Command makes 2 1/1s → Crusade triggers twice (+2/+2 to every creature including the new tokens) → Intangible Virtue anthem stacks +1/+1 base on the tokens = the two Krenko goblins enter as 4/4s with vigilance, and every other creature on your board grows by +2/+2. Aziza copy doubles the whole sequence.

Imperial Recruiter's ETB tutors any power-2-or-less creature. Both Kiki-Jiki (2/2) and Felidar Guardian (1/4) qualify, plus Walking Ballista (printed 0 power). One 3-MV body fetches both halves of the Kiki line (one piece per cast). Lowers combo assembly variance dramatically.

Imperial Recruiter tutors Walking Ballista (printed power 0). Heliod is 5/5 — too big for Imperial's filter, but Enlightened Tutor finds the artifact (Heliod is also a creature-enchantment but Enlightened only finds Heliod via the artifact slot — actually Heliod isn't an artifact, so Enlightened only finds him as an enchantment). Net: Imperial Recruiter is the only tutor for Walking Ballista; Enlightened Tutor is the only tutor for Heliod. Together they assemble the Heliod combo in 2-3 turns.

On the turn you assemble Kiki + Felidar, sacrifice Ranger-Captain → opponents can't cast noncreature spells this turn (no counterspells, no removal, no Cyclonic Rift). Combo resolves uncontested. Even better: Ranger-Captain's own ETB can tutor Mother of Runes to protect Kiki from creature removal first, then sac for the silence — two-layer combo protection from one card.

sources.name: DEC-303 v9 silence on combo turn

synergies.description: Mother of Runes taps to give Aziza protection from the most relevant color (typically blue for counterspells, black/red for removal). Keeps the commander on the field through removal so spell-copy chains continue. Free, repeatable protection at 1 MV.

Cast Empty the Warrens as the 3rd spell of your turn → 1 original + 2 storm copies + 1 Aziza copy = 4 spell events, each creating 2 1/1 goblins. With Anointed Procession + Mondrak (4x multiplier): 4 × 8 = 32 goblins. With +Elspeth (8x): 64. With +Ojer Taq (24x): 192. Storm copies are not cast (so Aziza doesn't re-copy them) but each storm copy is multiplied independently.

Guttersnipe triggers on every I/S **cast** (CR 707.10: Aziza copies are not cast, so the copy does not re-trigger Guttersnipe — but the original cast does). A turn where you cast 3 I/S spells: 3 × 2 = 6 damage to each opponent passively, on top of whatever the spells do AND whatever Aziza copies of those spells do. Pairs with Impact Tremors + Warleader's Call + Purphoros: 4 stackable damage triggers on creature ETB OR spell cast.

Two gates, both require Aziza ON THE BATTLEFIELD for full payoff. **Both-modes** gate: Jeska's Will's 'if you control a commander as you cast' — per CR 903.3d, 'controlling a commander' means a commander permanent on the battlefield. Aziza in the CZ does NOT satisfy this; you'd get only one mode. **Aziza-copy** gate: Aziza's triggered ability also requires her on the battlefield (with 3 untapped creatures available to tap). Full payoff scenario (Aziza on field + 3 untapped tokens): cast Jeska's Will → both modes resolve (R per card in target opp's hand + exile top 3 play this turn) → Aziza triggers, tap 3 → copy on stack → copy inherits both modes (CR 706.10d), re-target Mode 1 to another opponent. Net for {2}{R}: typically +8R to +14R generated AND 6 cards impulsed. CZ-only Aziza means one mode only and no copy — much smaller payoff. Play sequencing: resolve Aziza first (median T2), then deploy Jeska's Will T3+.

synergies.description: Imperial Recruiter's ETB tutors Mother of Runes (1/1). Mother of Runes then protects Aziza or your combo piece each turn with free protection-from-color. Two 3-MV plays = a defensive lock that keeps the copy engine alive against targeted removal.

v10 add (DEC-306). Flashback ({R} Instant, SOS): target any I/S in your graveyard gains flashback EOT (flashback cost = its mana cost). Two stacked Aziza interactions per cast: (1) Cast Flashback → Aziza copies it (tap 3), 2 graveyard targets gain flashback this turn (one from original cast, one from copy with new target). (2) Each subsequent flashback-recast of those spells is itself a cast → Aziza triggers AGAIN, copying the flashback-cast spell. Storm-Kiln Artist's Magecraft fires on every cast and every Aziza copy in this chain, generating Treasures that fund the next flashback. Best targets: Empty the Warrens (storm scales with the day's spell count), Secure the Wastes / Forth Eorlingas! / Grand Crescendo for X-spell go-wide, Krenko's Command for cheap reload, Jeska's Will for a second mana surge / impulse round. Replaces Magus of the Wheel's hand-refill role with deeper synergy density.

Walking Ballista (with ≥1 +1/+1 counter, achievable by casting with X≥1 or by Cathars' Crusade) pings for 1 → 1 life gained → Heliod's lifegain trigger places a +1/+1 counter on Ballista → repeat. Infinite damage; each opponent dies to direct damage.

winConditions.title: Kiki-Jiki + Felidar Guardian
winConditions.description: Kiki-Jiki taps to create a hasted copy of Felidar Guardian. The Felidar copy's ETB triggers, exiling Kiki and returning it (untapped, no summoning sickness due to haste from the previous copy). Kiki taps again to copy Felidar. Loop: infinite hasted 1/4 attackers. Closes via combat damage; with Impact Tremors / Purphoros / Warleader's Call also closes by infinite damage to each opponent.

winConditions.title: Kiki-Jiki + Restoration Angel
winConditions.description: Kiki-Jiki taps to create a hasted copy of Restoration Angel. The Angel copy's ETB triggers, exiling Kiki (non-Angel target) and returning it. Kiki taps to copy Angel again. Loop: infinite hasted 3/4 flying attackers. Same closer as the Felidar line. Provides a 5th combo piece, materially raising combo assembly probability.

winConditions.title: Kiki-Jiki + Felidar Guardian + Goblin Bombardment
winConditions.description: Alternate Kiki line via Goblin Bombardment. With Bombardment on the field, sacrifice each hasted Felidar copy for 1 damage to any target before the EOT exile trigger. Infinite damage to any single target — directly kills opponents or removes their boards through indestructible creatures.

winConditions.title: Combat go-wide (Crusade + Multipliers)
winConditions.description: Turn 5-6: with Cathars' Crusade + at least one multiplier (Anointed Procession, Mondrak, Elspeth, or Ojer Taq) on the field, a token spell creates N tokens (multiplied), each ETB stacks +N/+N counters on every creature you control via Crusade. Aziza copies the token spell for double output. With Intangible Virtue providing vigilance, swing for lethal on the same turn. Routinely 40+ damage across the table with Impact Tremors / Warleader's Call drains stacked.
